name: Undeath to Ash (Combat)
body:
You have mastered the art of bringing the destructive light of life to your undead opponents via your strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Lay on hands 4d6, worshiper of a deity of the sun.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a successful melee attack against an undead opponent, you may expend a single use of your lay on hands ability as a swift action to conduct this positive energy through your strike and into your foe. The opponent suffers the effects of both the melee attack and the damage from lay on hands.
